description: One exercise over time: personal records (heaviest, best estimated one-rep max, most reps, best session volume) and every session that included it, oldest first. Warm-ups and sets not done are excluded. pace is a straight line through the last 12 weeks of session estimated one-rep maxes (from weights and reps only), with where that line is in 4, 8 and 12 weeks; with target, also the day the line reaches it. pace is a projection at the current rate.

limit.description: Most recent sessions to return. Default 10.

target.description: A one-rep max to reach, in unit.

unit.description: Unit for every weight in this call. Defaults to the person's own unit.
